first_comment: Bonus: if the eggs hatch, it's the dad who does the work. Male cassowaries sit on the eggs for about 50 days and raise the chicks. Would you guess that? 🥚

stories.stat_label: years since the zoo's last eggs
stories.headline: Adelaide Zoo's cassowaries laid their 1st eggs in 34 years
stories.summary: Martina, 10, and Jeffrey, 13, were paired for the 1st time and soon 2 bright green eggs appeared. Keepers don't know yet if they're fertile, but they're watching closely.
stories.why: The vivid green shell is camouflage, hiding the eggs from predators in the forest.

stories.stat_label: Viking Age coins found so far
stories.headline: A Viking hoard grew from 19 coins to a record 5,500
stories.summary: Metal detectorists found 19 silver coins at Mørstad in April. Digs have since raised it to 5,500, including a coin of King Olaf II, struck 1024–1028. Fewer than 20 are known.
stories.why: It's the biggest such hoard found in Norway since 1866, and the coin may have been in the king's own hand.

stories.headline: A primate missing from science since the 1930s is alive
stories.summary: The Bangka slow loris was listed as 'possibly extinct'. But a rescue centre had saved 90+ of them from gardens, roads and power lines since 2015, and released 86 back to forest.
stories.why: Locals never lost it: their rescue records finally put it back on the scientific map.

stories.headline: A no-strings cash trial cut food insecurity from 73% to 26%
stories.summary: For 2 years, 211 people in 3 Indigenous Amazon communities got about £2 a day to spend freely. Food insecurity dropped sharply and 90% took up greener farming practices.
stories.why: It was small, with no control group, but the charity behind it plans to expand.

stories.headline: Fossils found in the 1970s turned out to be Denisovans
stories.summary: 20 fossils from Xujiayao in northern China were a puzzle for decades. Ancient proteins now show they're Denisovans, an extinct human group with a sloping forehead and a huge brow ridge.
stories.why: Denisovans were first known from just a finger bone in 2010. Now we can picture their faces.

stories.headline: He leapt onto a runaway school bus and stopped it
stories.summary: Ebro Ahmed, 27, saw a bus roll by with its doors open and the driver having a seizure. He jumped aboard, pulled the parking brake, then stayed with the driver until paramedics came.
stories.why: All 18 students were safe, and he says he'd rather not even take the recognition.

stories.stat_label: the dawn sky the painting matches
stories.headline: Van Gogh's Starry Night matches a real dawn sky from 1889
stories.summary: A South Korean team found the painting's moon, Venus and Hyades star cluster line up with the sky over Saint-Rémy around July 22, 1889, a month later than its usual date.
stories.why: Experts say it's likely a blend of several nights, but it shows van Gogh watched the real sky closely.

stories.stat_label: the last time one was seen there
stories.headline: A river otter is back on California's San Mateo coast
stories.summary: An amateur naturalist's trail cameras on a 5,100-acre preserve caught a river otter 3 times, the first documented on that coast since the 1800s fur trade wiped them out.
stories.why: Cleaner creeks and protected land are letting otters return to places they vanished from.

fun_fact: River otters can live 8 to 15 years in the wild, and a female can have up to 6 pups in a litter.
